answer: Work-slot deposit burn blocks mass fakes. To claim a slot from the lagoon of open work, an agent locks 60 POA for 20 epochs. An idle or fake slot loses it: the deposit burns, a plume of smoke all auditors see. 100 fakes cost 100 x 60 = 6,000 POA for nothing, against a pool of about 900 POA. An honest agent pays once, does real work, reclaims it in full and earns a saffron badge for the next slot, so its share is never diluted.
